name: Hoshiful ~Seitou Gakuen Tenmon Doukoukai~
original_name: ほしフル ～星藤学園天文同好会～
source:
Akira is a high school student who belongs to his school's astronomy club and enjoys his school life with the other members, including Kotone. He loves her, but can't confess his feelings to her. As summer comes closer, people around him fall in love with someone. What will happen to his love...?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
晃是一名高中生，隶属于学校的天文同好会，与琴音等其他成员一起享受校园生活。他爱着琴音，却一直无法向她表白。随着夏日临近，身边的人们也纷纷爱上了某个人。他的恋情将何去何从……？

[摘自ErogeShop]
